# updawg_notification_rule (Resource)

Which events go to which channels. A rule for `proposal.auto_merged` with no channels is how auto-merges are silenced. Needs the token scope `integrations`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "updawg_notification_rule" "security" {
  name        = "high-severity security to ops"
  event_types = ["proposal.opened", "proposal.auto_merged"]
  channel_ids = [updawg_notification_channel.ops.id]
  filter = {
    min_severity   = "high"
    proposal_kinds = ["security"]
  }
}

# A rule with no channels silences auto-merge notifications.
resource "updawg_notification_rule" "quiet" {
  name        = "no auto-merge noise"
  event_types = ["proposal.auto_merged"]
  channel_ids = []
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `channel_ids` (Set of String) `updawg_notification_channel` ids. May be empty.
- `event_types` (Set of String) Any of `proposal.opened`, `proposal.auto_merged`, `proposal.approved`, `proposal.merged`, `proposal.halted`, `host.stale`, `host.recovered`, `release.eol`.
- `name` (String) Unique in the organization.

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Defaults to `true`.
- `filter` (Attributes) Narrows the events; every field given must hold. The proposal fields do not narrow host events. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--filter))
- `org` (String) The organization's slug. Defaults to the provider's `org`. Changing it replaces the resource.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The rule's id, `nru_…`.

<a id="nestedatt--filter"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filter`

Optional:

- `known_exploited` (Boolean) Only proposals that fix something known to be exploited (`true`), or only those that do not (`false`).
- `min_severity` (String) At least this severe: `none`, `low`, `medium`, `high` or `critical`.
- `proposal_kinds` (Set of String) Only these kinds of proposal: `security`, `bugfix`, …

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import updawg_notification_rule.security acme/nru_0193a4b2c1d0
```
